reason: An ACP server bridge that integrates DeepSeek Harness with Zed, adding agent orchestration features including streamed responses, model and permission controls, session management, Zed file and terminal tools, and MCP support.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 通过 ACP 接入 Zed，并提供流式响应、模型与权限控制、会话管理、文件终端工具及 MCP 支持。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Zed through ACP with streamed responses, model and permission controls, session management, file and terminal tools, and MCP support.

capabilities: Streams model responses and reasoning through ACP
Connects Zed to DeepSeek Harness and configurable model providers
Manages permission presets and per-tool approval prompts
Reads and writes files through Zed integrations
Mounts MCP servers over stdio or streamable HTTP
Persists, resumes, archives, and deletes sessions
